cases.title: Discard password when Never For This Site is selected
cases.description: Verify that the browser discards the password after Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box.

cases.title: Available presented choices for multiple saved credentials
cases.description: Verify that when multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented.

cases.title: Pick up new password after change
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password for a website are saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Password manager disabled stops asking to save passwords
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager from the preferences panel is disabled, the browser no longer asks to save passwords.

cases.title: Password manager disabled stops prefilled info on sites
cases.description: Verify that when the password manager from the preferences panel is disabled, the browser no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved username and password through preferences
cases.description: Verify that when a username and password in the password manager are saved, this information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences.

cases.title: Removed credentials do not autofill on site
cases.description: Verify that after removing a username and password for a given site, it shall no longer autofill on that site.

cases.title: Removed credentials are not listed in password manager
cases.description: Verify that after removing a username and password for a given site, it shall no longer be listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information stops autofill
cases.description: Verify that after removing all username and password information, it shall no longer autofill.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information clears password manager list
cases.description: Verify that after removing all username and password information, nothing shall be listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All requirements have corresponding test cases covering their explicitly stated behaviors. No blockers or missing scenario gaps identified.

All requirements and cases have been thoroughly reviewed. There are no confirmed blockers, no missing scenario gaps, and no redundant excess cases. The test suite correctly covers all explicit behaviors and scenarios.

analysis.analysis: R-102: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: When Never For This Site is selected in the save password dialog box, the browser discards the password. R-103: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: When multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved, those same choices are later available to be presented. R-104: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: When a username and password for a website is saved and later the password is changed, the password manager picks up the new password. R-105: Multiple distinct behaviors (1) the browser shall no longer ask to save passwords, (2) the browser shall no longer get prefilled info on sites, when password manager from the preferences panel is disabled. R-106: Single straightforward acceptance criterion. Normal path: When a username and password in password manager is saved, this information can be viewed in the password manager through preferences. R-107: Multiple distinct behaviors (1) it shall no longer autofill on that site, (2) nor shall it be listed in password manager, when a username and password for a given site are removed. R-108: Multiple distinct behaviors (1) it shall no longer autofill, (2) nor shall anything be listed in password manager, when all username and password information is removed.
